flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures intracellular cytokine responses (IFNγ, IL2, TNFα in CD4+/CD8+ T cells after stimulation) in frozen PBMCs, whereas Record B measures surface chemokine receptor expression (CCR4, CCR6, CCR7, CXCR3 on CD4+ T cells) in PBMCs.
